tickets.title: Login error
tickets.description: User cannot access the platform due to an authentication error.

tickets.title: Sales page not loading
tickets.description: Sales dashboard fails to load for multiple users.

tickets.title: Update client data
tickets.description: Client requested corrections to personal and billing information.

tickets.title: Email sending failure
tickets.description: Automatic notification emails are not being delivered.

tickets.title: Monthly report error
tickets.description: The monthly performance report shows inconsistent numerical values.

tickets.title: User permission issues
tickets.description: Some users cannot access areas they previously had permissions for.

tickets.title: Misaligned design on mobile
tickets.description: Several UI components appear misaligned on mobile view.

tickets.title: Optimize image loading
tickets.description: High-resolution images generate slow load times across the app.

tickets.title: Database connection timeout
tickets.description: The production database is intermittently dropping connections under heavy load.

tickets.title: Footer links broken
tickets.description: The privacy policy and terms of service links in the footer redirect to a 404 page.

tickets.title: API rate limit implementation
tickets.description: Need to implement rate limiting for the Star Wars API endpoints to prevent abuse.

tickets.title: Dark mode contrast issues
tickets.description: Text in the sidebar is unreadable when dark mode is enabled.

tickets.title: CSV export failing
tickets.description: Exporting the filtered ticket list to CSV results in a server error (500).

tickets.title: Broken avatar upload
tickets.description: Users cannot upload profile pictures larger than 500KB.

tickets.title: Slow search query performance
tickets.description: Global search takes more than 5 seconds to return results from the tickets table.

tickets.title: Update React to v19
tickets.description: Schedule and execute the update to the latest React version for TicketFlow.

tickets.title: Missing translation strings
tickets.description: Several buttons in the 'Settings' menu are still showing in English on the Spanish locale.

tickets.title: Security vulnerability in dependency
tickets.description: Critical vulnerability found in 'axios' version currently used.

tickets.title: Wrong timestamp on ticket update
tickets.description: The 'updated_at' field is showing UTC instead of the local server time.

tickets.title: Duplicate notification emails
tickets.description: Clients are receiving the same notification email three times per update.

tickets.title: Inconsistent font styles
tickets.description: Headers on the dashboard are using Serif instead of the brand Sans-Serif.

tickets.title: Memory leak in useGlobal
tickets.description: The sidebar toggle listener is not being cleaned up, causing memory usage to grow.

tickets.title: Fix Star Wars API schema
tickets.description: Mismatch between SQL schema and Python SQLAlchemy models for the 'Planets' table.

tickets.title: Login page accessibility
tickets.description: Missing aria-labels on the login input fields.

tickets.title: Password reset link expires too fast
tickets.description: Link expires in 5 minutes; needs to be extended to 30 minutes.

tickets.title: Infinite scroll bug
tickets.description: The ticket list keeps loading the same first page when scrolling down.

tickets.title: Refactor SQLAlchemy models
tickets.description: Split models into separate files for better maintainability.

tickets.title: Dashboard chart not updating
tickets.description: Real-time statistics chart requires a manual page refresh to show new data.
